confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live price checks. Restaurant and beer/coffee anchors are moderately reliable for a July pricing window. Accommodation anchors (dorm, private hostel, 1-star, 3-star) are less certain because La Spezia has fewer hostels and its rates swing with Cinque Terre demand. Cocktail and wine were estimated relative to the beer and restaurant anchors because direct knowledge of local prices is weak. USD figures assume roughly 1.15 USD per EUR from general knowledge, not a live rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Ligurian and Tuscan coastal cities (e.g., Genoa, Pisa, Livorno) in peak summer, with a modest premium for Cinque Terre gateway tourism. No web search was used for city-price anchors.
